title: Reawait
description:
Plunge into an unpredictable underground adventure where your unexpected fall leads to entirely new challenges ! In REAWAIT, you have tumbled into a mysterious and deeply atmospheric cave and must navigate through a maze of ever-changing obstacles to reach your destination.

Using quick reflexes and clever strategy, you will need to find the safest path forward, overcome hazardous terrain, and survive a treacherous subterranean journey.

Key Features

• Game Features : Dive into a seamless 2D open world where your adventure never stops. Explore without loading screens, and never worry about losing progress thanks to full automatic saving.

• Dynamic Obstacle Courses: Dodge deadly traps, time your moves perfectly, and push your platforming skills to the limit as you progress deeper into the unknown.

• Unlockable Abilities: Discover and harness exciting new abilities that will help you bypass formerly impossible barriers and conquer difficult terrain.

• Secrets & Exploration: Delve deep into the cavernous maze to discover hidden secrets and lore buried beneath the surface.

• Pure Gameplay, No Distractions: Experience a focused adventure. The game requires no internet connection, contains zero ads, and features absolutely no in-app purchases or data collection .

• Controller Support: Fully optimized for both keyboard/mouse

Will you survive the depths and find your way back to the light? Descend into the unknown and play REAWAIT today.
description_short: Reawait is a challenging 2D open-world puzzles and action-adventure game where players explore a vast, seamless subterranean maze. To escape the deep cave network, you must navigate deadly traps, unlock new traversal abilities, and uncover hidden secrets
